artworks.title: Odysseus and Calypso
artworks.description: Two figures who cannot meet: the nymph glowing against her red drapery at the cave-mouth, the hero a dark back on a dark rock, staring at the sea that is the only way home.

artworks.title: Nausicaa
artworks.description: The Phaeacian princess pauses in a doorway, the ball games done — the girl on the edge of womanhood who found a salt-crusted stranger on the shore and led him to her father's hall.

films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: The miniseries gives Calypso's isle and the Phaeacian landing their screen duration — the last delays before Ithaca.

popCulture.title: Calypso (mythology)
popCulture.description: The nymph who keeps Odysseus seven years on Ogygia — love as detention until Hermes brings Zeus' release.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.description: Books V–XIII — from Calypso's cave to Scheria's ships — are the poem's long road home after Troy.
